sentence: From 2022-02-16 to 2026-11-17 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +43.5% a year (worst drawdown -33.1%) against +40.4% (-39.4%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 89% of stock-weeks. Sharpe ratio difference +0.05 (95% block-bootstrap CI [-0.12, +0.26]): deciding before the open has been **not distinguishable from deciding on the previous close**.
